modifications: All auction, bid, creative, site, app and publisher identifiers are synthetic.
All domains use reserved .test names; no real user IDs, IP addresses, consent strings or tracker endpoints.

Independently authored skippable-interstitial fixture (not a reproduction of a single named public example); imp.instl=1 with no rwdd differentiates it from the existing rewarded-portrait interstitial case.

Coverage closure: VAST3.0 XSD: move TrackingEvents after Duration within Linear. Corrected body independently validates with xmllint against pinned IAB VAST revision e0858cd714474bf17ef61065097456d7643ff838.
provenance.sanitized: No production payload or PII used. All resource and tracking hosts end in .test; external network must remain blocked.

pairApplicability.note: Use x-openrtb-version: 2.6 when replaying HTTP; envelope itself has no version field.

specNotes: skip=1/skipmin=10/skipafter=15 describe a plain skippable interstitial (no imp.rwdd) — distinct from the existing rewarded/portrait interstitial case, which uses skipafter=5/skipmin=0 and rwdd=1.
Linear skipoffset 00:00:15 matches imp.video.skipafter; skip/skipmin/skipafter are not validated by packages/core/rules-request.js (no finding either way).
Validity describes protocol structure and declared constraints; generated media bytes must be checked against declared MIME/duration before playback tests.
Current Inspector contract displays VAST as inert XML; text visibility must not be counted as creative rendering or media playback.
fixtureAssets lists controlled resources; intercept .test URLs locally. Never fetch public advertising/tracking hosts.
